title: 'Ramayana' day 19: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses Rs 1,704 cr worldwide

title: Ayan on 'War 2' failure with Hrithik: 'It was a franchise which belonged to somebody else'

title: Rakul chooses traditional Mekhela Chador priced at Rs 100,800 to celebrate Assam's weaving heritage
